title: Against Opacity
artist_birthplace: a mission station in the Kimberley
composition: a tent woven from blue tarpaulin large enough for six people, with cushions inside
claim: upends our grounding in time and space and makes way for imagined futures free of colonialism and capitalism
materials: clay bricks from a demolished factory
epigraph: "The undercommons is not a place but a practice." — Stefano Harney and Fred Moten
photo_style: installation view, white cube gallery, flat even lighting from fluorescent ceiling tubes, neutral colours, straight-on, no people, a wall label visible at the left, documentation photography, nothing dramatic
video_style: slow, black and white, silent, projected on a bare wall

foreign.translation: a longing for what is absent
